fixed.climate: none of its own: an enclosed earthy dream tunnel at the bottom of the falling dream

dream_design.rule: WR-010 / XA-magic-08 (dream, restrained: an earthen transition space)
dream_design.flora: tree roots thread through the tunnel walls and roof in long, twisting whiplash lines; the dry sticks and leaves of the heap keep their curled summer-dry forms
dream_design.ornament_cues: no built ornament; the roots naturally form an arching, arabesque lattice that leads toward the round glow of the hall lamps round the corner, the first hint of the hall's gilt roundels
dream_design.palette: earth umber, dry-leaf tan and ochre, with a faint amber-gold glow ahead
dream_design.seasonal_guard: summer-dry leaves, not wet autumn litter (unchanged)
dream_design.reason: The passage, the dark and the heap of sticks and dry leaves are explicit (ch001-p10..p11). Root lines and the glow cue are designed to WR-010, kept restrained so the hall reads as the reveal.

fixed.ground: a heap of dry sticks and dry leaves (summer-dry, brown and brittle, not wet autumn litter) on an earthen floor
fixed.dream_growth: Grows from the dry burrow under the hedge on a hot July day: dust-dry sticks and leaves, cool earth air, and the dark of a hole. A faint warm glow further down the passage comes from the hall's lamps round the corner. Heat and daylight only return as lamp-heat once she reaches the hall.

source.quote: she looked up, but it was all dark overhead; before her was another long passage

fixed.reason: Darkness overhead, the passage and the heap of sticks and dry leaves are explicit (ch001-p10, ch001-p11). The dry-summer reading of the leaves and the lamp-glow lead-in to the hall are designed per ruling 5.2 A.

states.diegetic_daylight: none; pitch dark above, dim warm glow ahead down the passage
states.conditions: thump onto the heap; a small puff of dry leaf-dust hangs in the still, cool air

source.quote: thump! thump! down she came upon a heap of sticks and dry leaves, and the fall was over

states.reason: The heap of sticks and dry leaves is explicit (ch001-p10). The leaf-dust, the glow and the clock are designed; the clock is continuous with the fall (story_timeline ev0002).

states.diegetic_daylight: none; all dark overhead, the passage lit only by lamp-glow spilling round the far corner from the hall
states.conditions: Alice's run stirs the still, cool air; the air warms toward the corner as the hall's lamp-heat reaches it

source.quote: she looked up, but it was all dark overhead; before her was another long passage, and the White Rabbit was still in sight, hurrying down it

states.reason: Darkness and the passage are explicit (ch001-p11). The Rabbit must stay visible, which needs a light source; the hall's lamps (ch001-p11) are used. The warming air is designed to hand over to the hot hall (ch002-p09).
